summary.text: Michelle Moge is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire State Senate, District 19, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Michelle Moge was a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives in Rockingham District 6 in 2020 and in Rockingham District 13 in 2022.
In 2024 she was the Democratic nominee for State Senate District 19 and lost the general election to incumbent Regina Birdsell.
In 2026 she advanced from the Democratic primary for the same seat, and Birdsell advanced from the Republican primary.
